text: The prompt success path saves credentials if the token changed or the granted scope changed. setRefreshToken uses oauth.scope ?? this._scope for the login realm and preserves origin and username matching. Scope-only changes therefore reach persistent login state. Keep both conditions when refactoring credential updates; saving only rotated token strings can leave stale permissions.
title: Persist changed OAuth scopes even when the refresh token string stays the same
